status: UNVALIDATED reference-guided rule proposals: thresholds & subfamily calls require benchmark calibration; no homology implies adhesome recruitment.
scope: Hierarchical homology annotation for comparative adhesome candidate screening

model_requirements.orthology_rule: Shared HOG is homology not orthology or paralog identity. Reciprocal lineage resolution required for specific calls.
model_requirements.benchmark_rule: No E-values, bit score deltas, margin thresholds, or confidence grades are validated by this JSON. Calibrate per clade via held-out phylogenetic references and outgroups.
model_requirements.function_rule: Protein identity and confirmed physical adhesome membership must be recorded separately.
model_requirements.topology_rule: SignalP/DeepTMHMM parsed cautiously; secretion/TM can contradict intracellular scaffold identity and support ECM/receptor cases; not proof alone.
model_requirements.control_leakage_warning: Calibration references used to create new rules cannot validate those same rules independently.
model_requirements.reference_scope: Calibration positive controls are experimentally verified human adhesion-associated proteins; identity rules are intended for independent application to distant proteomes.

integrin_alpha.classification_note: Variable detectable FG-GAP counts; alpha-specific stalk models recover divergent receptors. An alpha-I/VWA domain is optional, not required. No vertebrate alpha-subtype assignment.
integrin_alpha.label: integrin_alpha

fibronectin_III_ligand.classification_note: Legacy generic FNIII screening bucket, not a fibronectin-family assignment; reference FN1 moved explicitly to fibronectin_like in v4.
fibronectin_III_ligand.label: fibronectin_III_ligand

kindlin.classification_note: Kindlin-specific N-terminal model plus FERM/PH; PH insertion can interrupt FERM detection; generic FERM plus PH alone is insufficient.
kindlin.label: kindlin

actin.classification_note: Legacy name: do not classify as conventional actin from PF00022; evaluate actin_conventional versus ARP1-11.
actin.label: actin

cofilin.classification_note: Legacy name: PF00241 screens all ADF-H homologs; cannot diagnose CFL/ADF.
cofilin.label: cofilin

paxillin_like.classification_note: Legacy 3-LIM ambiguous screen; use PF03535/LD and reference sequence to assess paxillin family.
paxillin_like.label: paxillin_like

zyxin_like.classification_note: Legacy 3-LIM ambiguous screen; require specific reference evidence and negative controls.
zyxin_like.label: zyxin_like

FAK.classification_note: FAK-family includes PTK2/PTK2B/kin-32 relatives, including inactive kinases; PF03623 is focal adhesion targeting. PF02259 is PIKK FAT, not FAK. Human Y397 is not a transferable position.
FAK.label: FAK

Src.classification_note: Legacy name: generic SH3-SH2-TK screen, not an SFK assignment.
Src.label: Src

ILK.classification_note: ILK/pseudokinase: PF12796 Ank_2 plus kinase-like PF07714/PF00069, or legacy PF00023 repeats plus kinase. Alternative ankyrin HMMs are not additive repeat counts; catalytic activity is not required. Reciprocal evidence is needed.
ILK.label: ILK

PTP_PEST.classification_note: PTPN12/PTPN18/PTPN22-related PEST group, not one-to-one orthology. Requires reciprocal similarity extending at least 60 residues beyond catalytic-domain end or independent phylogeny; generic PxxP/PEST composition is not diagnostic.
PTP_PEST.label: PTP_PEST

LAR_RPTP.classification_note: LAR/type-IIa receptor PTP group (PTPRF/PTPRD/PTPRS); truncated relatives may be recovered by homology
LAR_RPTP.label: LAR_RPTP

RPTP_alpha_epsilon.classification_note: PTPRA/PTPRE/type-IV group; membrane topology is isoform dependent
RPTP_alpha_epsilon.label: RPTP_alpha_epsilon

generic_kinase_screen.classification_note: Generic catalytic-domain bucket; not an orthologous family or adhesion assignment

generic_PTP_screen.classification_note: Generic catalytic-domain bucket; not an orthologous family or adhesion assignment
generic_PTP_screen.label: generic_PTP_screen

fibronectin_like.classification_note: FN1/FN2/FN3 combination; counts need not match vertebrate FN1. Isolated repeat types are nonspecific. Partial architectures remain hypotheses unless independently resolved; no integrin-binding claim.
fibronectin_like.label: fibronectin_like

vitronectin_like.classification_note: Somatomedin-B followed by hemopexin-like region plus reciprocal family evidence. SMB occurs in ENPPs and hemopexin in proteases/HPX; neither alone assigns vitronectin.
vitronectin_like.label: vitronectin_like

generic_ECM_domain_screen.classification_note: Generic FN1/FN2/SMB/hemopexin domain bucket; extracellular location and adhesome membership are not inferred from a domain alone.
generic_ECM_domain_screen.label: generic_ECM_domain_screen

Syk.classification_note: Syk/ZAP70 family, not a one-to-one SYK orthology call. Tandem SH2 before kinase plus reciprocal family evidence; incomplete sequences stay provisional.
Syk.label: Syk

Csk.classification_note: CSK/MATK family. Shares SH3-SH2-kinase architecture with Src; reciprocal competition is essential. No Csk-specific motif or catalytic activity is inferred.
Csk.label: Csk

Nck.classification_note: NCK1/NCK2/dock family. Usually three SH3 domains before SH2; two detected SH3 are an allowed comparative alternative because NCK2 has an SH3_9 call outside the current HMM panel. No vertebrate paralogue assignment.
Nck.label: Nck

Grb2.classification_note: GRB2/drk family architecture; reciprocal evidence required. Shared architectures cannot resolve vertebrate paralogues. Candidate-rescue exception: distinct SH3 model PF14604 in GRB2 C-terminal region.

Crk.classification_note: CRK/CRKL family. SH2 before SH3 permits CRK-I and SH3_2 domains not represented in the current panel; reciprocal family evidence required.

Shc.classification_note: SHC1/2/3/4 family. PTB/PID before SH2 with reciprocal family evidence; no phosphosite or vertebrate paralogue assignment.

coactosin.classification_note: ADF-H homolog related to drebrin group; do not relabel as cofilin automatically.

LIM_scaffold_screen.classification_note: LIM zinc fingers are highly promiscuous; nuclear LIM-only/homeodomain/PDLIM proteins are adversarial negatives.
LIM_scaffold_screen.label: LIM_scaffold_screen

PINCH_like.classification_note: Five LIM domains characteristic of PINCH; must distinguish other multi-LIM proteins and verify family profile; four detected LIMs plus identity may be fragment. PINCH_like.label: PINCH_like

paxillin_family.classification_note: Paxillin-type N-terminal LD/PF03535 plus C-terminal LIMs; four LIM domains often expected; CDD paxillin LIM models helpful but must not distinguish PXN/LPXN/TGFB1I1 by themselves.
paxillin_family.label: paxillin_family

PXN.classification_note: PXN: requires paralog-resolving reference evidence; generic paxillin LIM or LD architecture does not discriminate.

LPXN.classification_note: LPXN: requires paralog-resolving reference evidence; generic paxillin LIM or LD architecture does not discriminate. Candidate-rescue exception: LPXN N-terminal LD/PF03535 may not be called by Pfam; require leupaxin-specific sequence evidence.

TGFB1I1.classification_note: TGFB1I1: requires paralog-resolving reference evidence; generic paxillin LIM or LD architecture does not discriminate.
